# archestra_mcp_gateway_skill_publication (Resource)

Authoritative skills published by one MCP gateway. Publication delegates content access to the gateway's callers. Declare one per gateway. Auto mode and explicit assignments persist independently; exclusions use archestra_mcp_gateway_skill_exclusions. Destroy disables Auto mode and clears explicit assignments, preserving the gateway and exclusions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One authoritative publication policy per gateway. Publishing a skill makes
# its content available to the gateway's callers.
resource "archestra_mcp_gateway_skill_publication" "procedures" {
  gateway_id        = archestra_mcp_gateway.operations.id
  access_all_skills = false
  skill_ids         = [archestra_skill.procedure.id]
}

# Auto mode retains explicit assignments; destroy disables Auto mode and clears
# those assignments while preserving the gateway and its independent exclusions.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_all_skills` (Boolean) Whether to publish all eligible organization skills automatically.
- `gateway_id` (String) MCP gateway UUID.
- `skill_ids` (Set of String) Complete explicit skill assignments, retained while Auto mode is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Gateway UUID identifying the publication policy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by MCP gateway UUID.
terraform import archestra_mcp_gateway_skill_publication.procedures 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
